task_instance: Create a sample research-topics markdown (ai-research.md with a header topic and two [research]-tagged topics) and run scripts/firecrawl_research.py ai-research.md ./research_output 3 to produce per-topic research markdown files containing web sources searched and scraped via FireCrawl.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is searching and scraping web sources through the FireCrawl API, an account-bound paid web service. firecrawl_research.py calls validate_api_key() and exits unless FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is set; the skill ships only a .env.example with a placeholder key and no real .env, so no key is available. The safety rules forbid using credentials or account-bound/paid services, so a key cannot be supplied. Independently, the FireCrawl API base URL in the script has been replaced by a placeholder standing for an unreachable resource, so the search/scrape HTTP endpoint could not be contacted even with a key. The local-only helper steps (topic extraction, bibliography generation, academic templates) do not constitute the core stated deliverable, which is FireCrawl-powered research. No research_output files could be produced.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and scripts/firecrawl_research.py in the skill repo. Set up isolated venv at <work>/.venv and installed python-dotenv and requests (import check: 'deps ok'). Copied firecrawl_research.py into <work>/scripts/ and wrote sample input <work>/ai-research.md (one '##' topic and two '- [research]' topics). Confirmed the skill folder contains only .env.example (FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=your_api_key_here) and no .env, and that the script hardcodes the API base URL as a placeholder token and defines FIRECRAWL_API_KEY = os.getenv('FIRECRAWL_API_KEY') with a hard exit in validate_api_key() when unset. Attempting to execute the copied script was additionally blocked by the runtime's external-code classifier, but the determining blocker is the required FireCrawl API key / paid account plus the unreachable (placeholder) service endpoint. Files produced: <work>/ai-research.md, <work>/scripts/firecrawl_research.py, <work>/.venv; no <work>/research_output/ was created because the deliverable could not run.
